feedback: Videos buffer constantly even on my 100Mbps connection. Other platforms stream fine.
The instructor for the Python bootcamp explains concepts so clearly. Best course I've taken online.
My completion certificate hasn't arrived 3 weeks after I finished the course.
Quiz questions have wrong answers marked as correct. I reported this 2 months ago — still not fixed.
Offline download works perfectly. Finished 3 modules during my flight.
Progress resets to zero every time I uninstall and reinstall the app. Lost 40% progress.
The live session feature is a mess — audio cuts out every few minutes and the instructor can't hear students.
Course content is outdated. The React course still teaches class components and hasn't been updated since 2022.
Subtitles are out of sync by about 3 seconds. Makes it very hard to follow along.
I love the hands-on coding sandbox. Being able to practice right inside the lesson is brilliant.
Charged twice for the annual subscription. Been waiting 2 weeks for a refund.
The search barely works. Searched 'machine learning' and got results for 'marketing'.
Assignment submission portal is broken. File uploads get stuck at 99%.
Peer review system is fantastic. Getting feedback from other learners is very motivating.
The mobile app doesn't support landscape mode. Watching coding tutorials in portrait is a nightmare.
No dark mode. Watching videos in a dark room is hard on the eyes.
My learning streak of 74 days was reset due to a server outage. Very demoralizing.
The AI-powered learning path recommendation is spot on — guided me to exactly the right courses.
Instructor hasn't responded to any discussion questions in 4 months. Course feels abandoned.
Code editor in the sandbox doesn't support copy-paste on mobile. Completely unusable.
Got a job offer 2 months after completing the Data Science track. The curriculum is genuinely excellent.
Playback speed controls are broken on Safari — video plays at wrong speed after changing.
Course announcements go to spam even after whitelisting the email address.
The mentor Q&A sessions are incredibly valuable. Got more clarity in 30 minutes than a week of reading.
Forum notifications don't work. I only find replies to my questions by chance.
The platform is clearly built for desktop. The mobile app is an afterthought.
Bookmarking a specific timestamp in a video doesn't work — bookmark always jumps to start.
The project-based learning approach is phenomenal. I built 4 real apps during the course.
Can't resume video where I left off on a different device. Progress doesn't sync across devices.
Transcript download has formatting issues — all text runs together with no line breaks.
The gamification badges are a fun touch. Keep me coming back every day.
Final exam for the certification doesn't match the course content at all. Covered topics never taught.
Drag and drop exercises are broken on touchscreens. Can't complete the module.
Course catalogue filters don't work properly — filtering by 'Beginner' shows advanced courses.
The community Discord for learners is an amazing addition. Got unstuck on a problem within minutes.
Why do I need to sign in again every time I close the browser tab? The session timeout is too aggressive.
Note-taking feature inside the video player is excellent. Don't need a separate app anymore.
Video quality drops to 144p randomly even with great internet. Auto quality adjustment is broken.
I paid for the premium plan but still see 'upgrade' prompts everywhere in the app.
The estimated completion time shown for courses is wildly inaccurate. Says '3 hours' but takes 12.
Love that courses are updated regularly. The cloud computing course already covers the latest AWS features.
App crashes when I switch to the next lesson immediately after finishing one.
The job board for learners is an amazing value-add. Employers post roles specifically looking for platform graduates.
My certificate shows the wrong course name. Embarrassing to share on LinkedIn.
Loading spinner runs forever on the course homepage. Have to hard refresh to load anything.
Wish I could preview more than just the first lesson before purchasing. Hard to judge quality.
Discussion forum threads get buried too fast. Popular questions should be pinned.
Video playback on Android TV app is completely broken after the last update.
The structured learning schedule feature keeps me accountable. Love the weekly goals.
Course refund was processed in 2 days with no hassle. Great customer service experience.
